# Lahza

> A UAE gifting and event-activation platform (operated by Beyond Connect General Trading L.L.C) that turns customer photos and memories into luxury personalised coffee gifts, live interactive event coffee stations, and corporate appreciation campaigns — with full English and Arabic support and delivery across all seven Emirates.

## What we offer
- Personalised coffee gift boxes: a customer photo and a message (Arabic or English) printed on cups, sleeves, gift boxes and gift cards. Consumer prices from AED 89, VAT-inclusive.
- Live event coffee stations: half-day, full-day and premium activation packages with selfie-coffee / latte-art printing and branded cups. Transparent day-rates from AED 2,500 (excl. VAT).
- Corporate & bulk campaigns: appreciation gifting at scale with branded boxes, tiered per-unit pricing and full VAT tax invoices.

## Key facts
- Coverage: all 7 Emirates; delivery windows are confirmed per order via WhatsApp.
- Languages: English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL), with UAE-appropriate Arabic copy.
- Ordering & payment: orders are placed via WhatsApp; the team confirms totals and available payment options in the chat.
- Compliance: VAT-inclusive consumer pricing; personalised goods are non-returnable except when faulty (UAE Consumer Protection Law); PDPL photo consent with 30-day source-image deletion.
